name: unlinked
description: Start public investor shortlists without sign-in at https://www.unlinked.ai/search-public?q=gaming%20investor or GET /api/people?q=gaming%20investor; return source profile links and label partial coverage. MCP tools still require OAuth; web/HTTP-enabled hosts can use the public route before optional account setup. Search your owner-scoped imported network and the complete published professional People index with an explicitly revocable account grant. Recovered Connections observations require the same confirmed owner; original files are browser-only and excluded from grants. Current grants add whoami, deterministic paginated listings and an explicit AI search tool; old valid grants receive current tools within their enabled permissions and original data scope, without changing token bytes. The same tools are served as a grant-authenticated HTTP JSON API under /api/agent/v1/ (contract: docs/agent-api.md). Professional profile details and privacy boundaries: docs/profile-details.md. Private notes can attach to a public profile that appears later through its exact published LinkedIn URL. Reads stay owner-only and do not create profiles, publish notes, or create connections; names, emails and profile-ID spelling are not identity evidence.

authentication.provisioning: Manual key setup: https://www.unlinked.ai/agents. Lifecycle and release contract: docs/agent-key-settings.md in the repository.

oauth.revocation: Settings → Connected apps, or RFC 7009 at /oauth/revoke

authentication.manualKeyPermissions: Manual-key controls and connector choice: docs/agent-key-settings.md. Historical-grant normalization, tool refresh and OAuth permission consent: docs/agent-api.md (repository).

tools.name: unlinked_search_network
tools.description: Search the owner's imported network, or pass degree 1/2 plus an optional cursor to read recorded public paths from the explicitly confirmed recovered profile.

tools.name: unlinked_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated grant owner: stable Unlinked owner id, grant scope/version/tools, import count and confirmed legacy anchor if any. Linkage is the grant itself, never email matching.

tools.name: unlinked_list_people
tools.description: Deterministically list or lexically filter the published public People index. sort: best (default), name (ignores leading emoji/punctuation, accents and case), name-desc or raw (code-point order). Opaque cursor bound to query and sort, max 50 per page, total and snapshot revision. Public fields only. MCP profile/list/contact results expose enrichmentStatus independently of presence and detailLevel. Values are enriched (current published enrichment evidence), not_recorded (no such evidence in the composed index), and unknown (source has no status). not_recorded does not prove a person was never enriched. unlinked_list_people accepts presence and enrichmentStatus filters.

sort.description: best (default): relevance with q, else stored name order; name: A–Z from the first letter or number, ignoring leading emoji/punctuation, accents and case (names are returned as written); name-desc; raw: Unicode code-point order of the name as written. Bound into the cursor.

tools.name: unlinked_list_connections
tools.description: Deterministically list the owner's connections. Degree 1 includes owner-imported contacts (no anchor required) plus recorded public paths when anchored, grouped one entry per person (exact published-profile or LinkedIn-address evidence, never names) with sources[]; grouping none returns one row per source. Degree 2 returns only recorded public paths with the proving path, or typed degree_unproven. sort: name (default, ignores leading emoji/punctuation), raw, name-desc, connected, imported, company.

sort.description: name (default): A–Z from the first letter or number, ignoring leading emoji/punctuation, accents and case (names are returned exactly as written); raw: Unicode code-point order of the name as written; name-desc; connected: most recently connected first; imported: most recently imported first; company: A–Z by company, none last. Bound into the cursor.

grouping.description: Degree 1. person (default): one entry per person, grouped only on exact identity evidence — the same published profile (merges followed) or the same LinkedIn address, never a name — with sources[] listing every underlying record and top-level fields from the owner import; total counts people. none: one row per source record (pre-grouping shape). Bound into the cursor.

tools.name: unlinked_get_profile
tools.description: Read one published public profile by id or profile handle with its public connections page (profiles with a readable address include handle and url); typed not_found otherwise.

tools.name: unlinked_ai_search
tools.description: Explicit AI tool. scope 'mine' ranks only your own imported network; scope 'everyone' ranks the published public index and requires a public-scope grant. Owner role queries require supplied title evidence, omit domain-only matches and give short conversational reasons stating unknown sector focus. Set timeoutMs to bound latency.

tools.name: unlinked_list_connection_requests
tools.description: Read-only: list open requests; acting requires the separate explicit opt-in connection scope.

tools.name: unlinked_list_notifications
tools.description: Read-only: the owner's newest in-app notifications with unseen/unread counts. Reading does not mark anything seen or read.

tools.name: unlinked_lookup_contact
tools.description: Read-only, owner-scoped: resolve one of the owner's own contacts by connectionId, linkedinUrl or published profileId (or up to 100 linkedinRefHash values) without paging. Returns name, headline, company, connectionId, linkedinRefHash (SHA-256 of the canonical LinkedIn slug) and publishedProfileId when the person has a published profile.

tools.name: unlinked_send_connection_request
tools.description: Send a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_accept_connection_request
tools.description: Accept a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_ignore_connection_request
tools.description: Ignore a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_withdraw_connection_request
tools.description: Withdraw a connection request. Only with explicit opt-in; off by default. Same browser authorization and limits.

tools.name: unlinked_get_person_private
tools.description: Read the owner’s private card about an Unlinked person: profileId may be a published profile id, a connection id from unlinked_list_connections (an imported LinkedIn contact) or a linkedin.com/in/ address. Returns the notes and relations recorded about that person (with note and link ids for corrections), plus profileId, connectionId and linkedinRefHash when they apply. entities is empty when nothing is recorded yet. Notes and relations carry author (“owner” or “agent:<client>”), source (“app”, “connector”, “direct-key” or “suggestion”) and assertion (“stated” or “inferred”); null on records made before provenance was kept. Relations also carry relationType. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_get_private_thing
tools.description: Read one of the owner’s private entities (a saved person, company, idea, project or list, or any entity id from another private tool) with its notes and relations. Pass limit (1–100) and follow nextCursor as after to read every relation; without these arguments the legacy read is bounded at 500 links. Notes and relations carry author (“owner” or “agent:<client>”), source (“app”, “connector”, “direct-key” or “suggestion”) and assertion (“stated” or “inferred”); null on records made before provenance was kept. Relations also carry relationType. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_list_private_things
tools.description: List the owner’s private entities (saved people, companies, ideas, projects and lists, and Unlinked or OpenChat people they wrote about), optionally by name and kind. Pass limit (1–100) and follow nextCursor as after for complete enumeration; query is not supported with pagination. Without pagination the legacy name listing is bounded at 50. Use kind list to discover lists, then read contains relations using unlinked_get_private_thing with limit. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_search_private
tools.description: Search the owner’s private people knowledge in one call: entities matched by name or private note text, and relations matched by relation text, either end’s name, or relationType (knows, family, works_at, worked_with, works_on, attended, interested_in, other). Give at least one of query, relationType or kind. At most 50 of each; truncated says more matched. Notes and relations carry author (“owner” or “agent:<client>”), source (“app”, “connector”, “direct-key” or “suggestion”) and assertion (“stated” or “inferred”); null on records made before provenance was kept. Relations also carry relationType. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_get_neighbourhood
tools.description: Read one person or thing and what surrounds it in the owner’s private graph: everything one (default) or two private relations away, and those relations (fromId/toId). subjectKind “unlinked” = an Unlinked person: a published profile id, a connection id from unlinked_list_connections (an imported LinkedIn contact) or a linkedin.com/in/ address (the same person is one entity whichever you give); “thing” = one of the owner’s saved people, companies, ideas or projects (its id); “user” = an OpenChat person (user id) the owner already has private notes about. Never creates anything; empty when nothing is recorded. Bounded; truncated says it was cut. Notes and relations carry author (“owner” or “agent:<client>”), source (“app”, “connector”, “direct-key” or “suggestion”) and assertion (“stated” or “inferred”); null on records made before provenance was kept. Relations also carry relationType. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_save_private_thing
tools.description: Find or save a private person, company, idea, project or list by name, for someone with no Unlinked profile or imported contact (“remember Maya from dinner”). Returns its id for notes and links. A name is reused only when it names exactly one saved thing; when several share it the call fails with code ambiguous_name and candidates — ask the user which one. Set createNew true with a clientRequestId only to save a different one with an existing name; retries return the same entity. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_add_private_note
tools.description: Add a private note about a person or thing. subjectKind “unlinked” = an Unlinked person: a published profile id, a connection id from unlinked_list_connections (an imported LinkedIn contact) or a linkedin.com/in/ address (the same person is one entity whichever you give); “thing” = one of the owner’s saved people, companies, ideas or projects (its id); “user” = an OpenChat person (user id) the owner already has private notes about. Adding the same text again returns the existing note. Recorded as written by this agent (author agent:<key or app name>, source direct-key). Set assertion “inferred” when you concluded it yourself. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_delete_private_note
tools.description: Delete (undo) one of the owner’s private notes by note id. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_add_private_link
tools.description: Record a private relation in the owner’s own words (“knows”, “sister of”, “worked with”, “works at”), for example that one imported contact knows another. Subject: subjectKind “unlinked” = an Unlinked person: a published profile id, a connection id from unlinked_list_connections (an imported LinkedIn contact) or a linkedin.com/in/ address (the same person is one entity whichever you give); “thing” = one of the owner’s saved people, companies, ideas or projects (its id); “user” = an OpenChat person (user id) the owner already has private notes about. Target: toKind “unlinked” + toId (published profile id, connection id or linkedin.com/in/ address), toKind “user” + toId (OpenChat user id already in the owner’s private notes), or toKind person/company/idea/project/list with toId (saved thing id) or toName. A name is reused only when it names exactly one saved thing; when several share it the call fails with code ambiguous_name and candidates — ask the user which one, then pass its id. Set createNew true with a clientRequestId only to save a different one with an existing name. The same subject, relation and target is one link, so retries never duplicate. Recorded as written by this agent (author agent:<key or app name>, source direct-key). relationType is derived from the words. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_update_private_link
tools.description: Correct one of the owner’s private relations in place by link id, for example “sister of” to “cousin of”. The relation text, its relationType and the link’s identity change together; if the owner already has that exact relation between the same two ends, the two become one and the existing link is returned with merged true. Recorded as written by this agent (author agent:<key or app name>, source direct-key). Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_delete_private_link
tools.description: Delete (undo) one of the owner’s private relations by link id. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_delete_private_thing
tools.description: Delete (undo) one of the owner’s private entities by id: removes it with its private notes and every private relation to or from it. Cannot be reversed. Deleting an entity about an Unlinked person forgets only the owner’s private notes; the profile and contact are untouched. Owner-only private knowledge: visible only to the owner (never to the person it is about), stored in the owner’s Ideaflow people overlay and shown in Unlinked (person and contact pages) and OpenChat. Never notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_stage_investor_csv
tools.description: Inspect or stage an investor/contact CSV or XLSX in the owner’s private database (the tool name remains compatible). Supply exactly one of csv (UTF-8 text) or fileBase64 (canonical base64 original bytes, requires filename ending .csv or .xlsx); maximum original size 512 KiB. inspectOnly:true writes nothing and needs no mapping/listName: XLSX returns exact sheet names, ids, paths and visibility; with sheet set it also returns headers. XLSX staging always requires an exact sheet name, headerRow (1 by default), mapping, listName, and retainOriginalConfirmed:true ONLY after owner authorization to retain the ENTIRE original workbook including unselected/hidden tabs privately on the server. Only the selected sheet is imported; never guess a tab. Selected-sheet formulas, macros, encrypted or legacy .xls files are rejected; supply a values-only XLSX or CSV. Mapping uses exact header names; private comments use notes:[column names]. Returns importId and a new import’s validation preview; resume to commit. Same bytes, sheet/header, mapping, listName and list target replay the same import. Name/email never auto-match; exact LinkedIn references may match a readable persona, otherwise each source row becomes a private person. listId appends to an existing private list. Larger files must be split by complete rows, retaining headers; append later parts to the first listId. Requires Private people notes & relations permission. Owner-only; never publishes profiles or notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_resume_investor_import
tools.description: Commit/resume one bounded batch (default 10, maximum 25 rows) from a staged CSV or selected XLSX sheet. Repeat with the same importId until status complete or partial; never report completion before then. Durable row receipts and idempotent graph writes survive process restarts. import_busy means retry later. On other errors, progress is retained: inspect status and retry after fixing the cause. Existing graph quotas apply (5,000 entities and links per owner). Requires Private people notes & relations permission. Owner-only; never publishes profiles or notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

tools.name: unlinked_get_investor_import
tools.description: Read an investor import’s status and private original row fields with outcome receipts, including XLSX sheet and physical row provenance. Page with nextOffset until null, at most 20 rows per call, fewer when encoded fields are large. Oversized rows report sourceRecovery. Recover the original file with sourceOffset:0 and follow source.nextOffset until null. CSV returns source.text chunks (UTF-16 offsets, at most 32768 code units); XLSX returns source.base64 chunks (BYTE offsets, at most 32768 bytes). Decode EACH base64 chunk separately, concatenate bytes and verify sourceDigest. The entire original XLSX includes unselected/hidden sheets and remains owner-private. A partial import has rejected rows; inspect reasons. This reads original outcomes, not the owner’s subsequent graph edits/deletions. Query live lists with unlinked_list_private_things(kind:list,limit:100) and unlinked_get_private_thing(thingId:listId,limit:100), following nextCursor. Requires Private people notes & relations permission. Owner-only; never publishes profiles or notifies anyone. It is NOT a connection request and NOT messaging.

connectionBrowsing.description: Page depth describes visible content, independently of membership. Only published connections are browsed.

publicWebSearch.scope: published professional People only; excludes private networks and contact details

alternateTransport.scope: same live canonical public page; no credentials forwarded or stored publication

messaging.agentCredential: Separate OpenChat oc_ key for messages and Context; Unlinked grants cannot send messages.

browserCardSharing.contactCardJoin: Explicit browser-only same-origin POST /c/<token>/add preserves the card through verified signup and adds the connection. Scanning alone does not connect. Not an agent capability.

requestDiagnostics.privacy: No credentials, queries, result bodies or sensitive URL parameters. Opaque account correlation only after successful authentication.
requestDiagnostics.gatewayLimitation: Shared gateway does not currently forward the downstream Unlinked request ID.

publicPeoplePresence.description: Presence semantics and the historical-account reclaim boundary are owned by docs/public-people-reader.md#historical-membership in the repository.

agentAccess.unlistedClients: Custom API connector with OpenAPI and a named account key when supported; Muse OAuth unverified.
agentAccess.accountConsent: Use verified user identity and explicit delegated consent; no silent agent-created accounts or quota evasion.

profileStatus: MCP profile/list/contact results expose enrichmentStatus independently of presence and detailLevel. Values are enriched (current published enrichment evidence), not_recorded (no such evidence in the composed index), and unknown (source has no status). not_recorded does not prove a person was never enriched. unlinked_list_people accepts presence and enrichmentStatus filters.

verifiedAccess.scope: visible published network or own network; optional query and selected IDs
verifiedAccess.constraints: Existing visibility, consent, external-provider allowances and transport bounds remain.
